models.limits: Logical TCPProbeSessions bookkeeping only. Seed prefixes are documented; no unbounded safety/liveness, Go concurrency refinement, full limits arithmetic, timer/suspension (the 2*MSL tuple quarantine is an abstract quiesce step after drain), packet parsing/checksums/ARP/encoding, gVisor TCP sequence semantics, exact context hook scheduling, physical ownership/atomic revocation/delivery fencing, OS NIC cleanup or process restart proof. Parsed tuple/direction validity is an abstract input predicate. An admitted callback may already have effects after revocation; effectPossible remains sticky and does not certify cleanup. Persistent transport queues/pumps are separate obligations and not bound here.
